address: Simmonscourt Rd, Dublin, Ireland, D04 A9K8
bio: Enjoy an Afternoon Tea in The Lobby Lounge at the InterContinental Dublin Hotel. This luxurious lounge looks onto the hotel's stunning garden terrace and is the perfect place to relax or meet with friends and family.  Afternoon Tea is served in The Reading Room, an elegant dining area with huge windows showcasing the picturesque scenes of the beautiful hotel garden.  Their menu features a selection of classic finger sandwiches including their Lobster Roll and their Tomato Bread with Prosciutto and Dubliner Cheese. Indulge in an array of scones and citrus tarts and pastries including their Watermelon and Lime Vacherin and Apricot and Almond Entremet, served alongside a wide selection of twenty five teas.  The Lobby Lounge at the InterContinental Hotel Dublin is located close to Herbert Park and Ballsbridge, and is within close proximity of Sandymouth train station .
